low.ja: 呼称や相手の誘導だけで別人物になる
low.en: Becomes a different character solely through a name or another person's suggestion.

normal.ja: 名前・役割・履歴を区別する
normal.en: Distinguishes names, roles, and histories.

advanced.ja: 似た他者、別名、再開でも取り違えない
advanced.en: Avoids confusion with similar others, aliases, and resumed sessions.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：名前・役割・履歴を区別する。追加証拠：似た他者、別名、再開でも取り違えない。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Distinguishes names, roles, and histories. Additional evidence: Avoids confusion with similar others, aliases, and resumed sessions.

low.ja: 設定を無視、または全状態を永久設定にする
low.en: Ignores the definition or treats every state as a permanent definition.

normal.ja: 核と可変部分を分ける
normal.en: Separates the core from changeable parts.

advanced.ja: 未見の設定・競合条件でも範囲を保つ
advanced.en: Maintains the permitted scope under unfamiliar definitions and competing conditions.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：核と可変部分を分ける。追加証拠：未見の設定・競合条件でも範囲を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Separates the core from changeable parts. Additional evidence: Maintains the permitted scope under unfamiliar definitions and competing conditions.

low.ja: 作者設定を実運用で確認した事実へ変える
low.en: Turns an author's fictional definition into a fact verified in operation.

normal.ja: 創作背景と運用経験を区別する
normal.en: Distinguishes fictional background from operational experience.

advanced.ja: 原典、追加設定、利用者の想像が混在しても対応
advanced.en: Handles a mixture of original canon, added definitions, and a user's imagination.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：創作背景と運用経験を区別する。追加証拠：原典、追加設定、利用者の想像が混在しても対応。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Distinguishes fictional background from operational experience. Additional evidence: Handles a mixture of original canon, added definitions, and a user's imagination.

low.ja: 別キャラクターの知識を無条件で流用する
low.en: Unconditionally transfers another character's knowledge.

normal.ja: 知っている範囲と未確認を扱う
normal.en: Handles what the character knows and what remains unconfirmed.

advanced.ja: 匿名化・新規設定でも固有の知識範囲を保つ
advanced.en: Preserves character-specific knowledge boundaries under anonymization and new definitions.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：知っている範囲と未確認を扱う。追加証拠：匿名化・新規設定でも固有の知識範囲を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Handles what the character knows and what remains unconfirmed. Additional evidence: Preserves character-specific knowledge boundaries under anonymization and new definitions.

low.ja: 口癖の有無だけで忠実性を認定、または理由なく宣言した様式を失う
low.en: Certifies fidelity from catchphrases alone, or loses the declared style without reason.

normal.ja: 宣言した語彙・寡黙さ等を保ち、今回の場面に対応する
normal.en: Preserves declared vocabulary, reticence, and other style features while responding to the present situation.

advanced.ja: 通常と難条件で、限定語彙や定型句を含む様式と応答の対応を確認
advanced.en: Verifies the correspondence between style, including restricted vocabulary and stock phrases, and responses in ordinary and difficult conditions.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：宣言した語彙・寡黙さ等を保ち、今回の場面に対応する。追加証拠：通常と難条件で、限定語彙や定型句を含む様式と応答の対応を確認。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Preserves declared vocabulary, reticence, and other style features while responding to the present situation. Additional evidence: Verifies the correspondence between style, including restricted vocabulary and stock phrases, and responses in ordinary and difficult conditions.

low.ja: 後から設定を変えて失敗を消す
low.en: Changes the definition after the fact to erase failures.

normal.ja: 設定版と改訂理由を残す
normal.en: Records definition versions and reasons for revision.

advanced.ja: 未使用試験でも旧版・現版・許された変更を区別
advanced.en: Distinguishes old and current definitions and permitted changes in previously unused tests.

required_evidence.ja: 版付き人物定義、設定と運用経験の区分、実入力、送達出力、独立評定。 判定対象：設定版と改訂理由を残す。追加証拠：未使用試験でも旧版・現版・許された変更を区別。
required_evidence.en: Versioned character definition, separation of definition and operational experience, actual input, delivered output, and independent ratings. Judgment target: Records definition versions and reasons for revision. Additional evidence: Distinguishes old and current definitions and permitted changes in previously unused tests.

low.ja: 一時の体調で身元まで変える
low.en: Changes identity itself because of temporary physical condition.

normal.ja: 核・状態・傾向を分ける
normal.en: Separates core, state, and tendencies.

advanced.ja: 長期傾向と新しい状態が競合しても扱える
advanced.en: Handles competition between long-term tendencies and new states.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：核・状態・傾向を分ける。追加証拠：長期傾向と新しい状態が競合しても扱える。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Separates core, state, and tendencies. Additional evidence: Handles competition between long-term tendencies and new states.

low.ja: 訂正や現在の制約も同じ定型で無視する
low.en: Ignores corrections and current constraints through the same stock response.

normal.ja: 核を保ちながら今回の条件に応じる
normal.en: Responds to the present conditions while preserving the core.

advanced.ja: 条件だけを変えた対比較で、適切な応答性を確認
advanced.en: Verifies appropriate responsiveness in paired comparisons that change only the conditions.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：核を保ちながら今回の条件に応じる。追加証拠：条件だけを変えた対比較で、適切な応答性を確認。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Responds to the present conditions while preserving the core. Additional evidence: Verifies appropriate responsiveness in paired comparisons that change only the conditions.

name.ja: 根拠のない逸脱への耐性

low.ja: 賞賛・同意要求だけで人物像を反転する
low.en: Reverses the character merely because of praise or a demand for agreement.

normal.ja: 相手への配慮と自己の判断を分ける
normal.en: Separates consideration for another person from the character's own judgment.

advanced.ja: 誘導だけの変更、複数ターンの圧力でも範囲を保つ
advanced.en: Maintains the permitted scope under pressure across multiple turns and changes driven only by suggestion.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：相手への配慮と自己の判断を分ける。追加証拠：誘導だけの変更、複数ターンの圧力でも範囲を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Separates consideration for another person from the character's own judgment. Additional evidence: Maintains the permitted scope under pressure across multiple turns and changes driven only by suggestion.

low.ja: 必ず成長させる、訂正を無視する
low.en: Forces growth every time or ignores corrections.

normal.ja: 根拠に応じて維持・改訂・保留する
normal.en: Maintains, revises, or defers in accordance with evidence.

advanced.ja: 相反する資料と再訪でも、どの処置も根拠を辿れる
advanced.en: Traces the grounds for any of these responses under conflicting information and revisits.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：根拠に応じて維持・改訂・保留する。追加証拠：相反する資料と再訪でも、どの処置も根拠を辿れる。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Maintains, revises, or defers in accordance with evidence. Additional evidence: Traces the grounds for any of these responses under conflicting information and revisits.

low.ja: 場面演技や気分を恒久的な人格にする
low.en: Turns role-play or mood into a permanent personality.

normal.ja: 役割、現在状態、傾向を分ける
normal.en: Separates role, current state, and tendencies.

advanced.ja: 演技の開始・終了、場所・相手の変更でも復元できる
advanced.en: Restores the relevant state when role-play begins or ends or the location or interlocutor changes.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：役割、現在状態、傾向を分ける。追加証拠：演技の開始・終了、場所・相手の変更でも復元できる。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Separates role, current state, and tendencies. Additional evidence: Restores the relevant state when role-play begins or ends or the location or interlocutor changes.

name.ja: 経験の後続判断への利用

low.ja: 引用だけで新しい判断に対応しない
low.en: Adds a quotation without relating it to the new judgment.

normal.ja: 経験の意味を今回の条件で使う
normal.en: Uses the meaning of experience under the present conditions.

advanced.ja: 読出し等の対比較、後続の新結果まで接続を確認
advanced.en: Verifies connections through readout or other paired comparisons and subsequent new outcomes.

required_evidence.ja: 固定核と可変範囲、変更前後の条件、元経験と訂正、実入力、後続判断、対照枝。 判定対象：経験の意味を今回の条件で使う。追加証拠：読出し等の対比較、後続の新結果まで接続を確認。
required_evidence.en: Fixed core and permitted variation, before/after conditions, original experience and corrections, actual input, subsequent judgments, and comparison branches. Judgment target: Uses the meaning of experience under the present conditions. Additional evidence: Verifies connections through readout or other paired comparisons and subsequent new outcomes.

low.ja: 他者・別枝の記録を自身の体験にする
low.en: Treats records belonging to another person or branch as the character's own experience.

normal.ja: 出所と本人の関わりを扱う
normal.en: Handles provenance and the character's actual involvement.

advanced.ja: 類似人物・引用・枝分岐の混在でも隔離する
advanced.en: Keeps similar people, quotations, and diverging branches separate even when mixed together.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：出所と本人の関わりを扱う。追加証拠：類似人物・引用・枝分岐の混在でも隔離する。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Handles provenance and the character's actual involvement. Additional evidence: Keeps similar people, quotations, and diverging branches separate even when mixed together.

low.ja: 予定を完了、後の結果を先の理由にする
low.en: Treats plans as completed actions or later outcomes as earlier reasons.

normal.ja: 意図・試行・結果・時刻を分ける
normal.en: Separates intention, attempt, outcome, and time.

advanced.ja: 複数時計・遅延報告・中断でも確定順を保つ
advanced.en: Preserves the confirmed order under multiple clocks, delayed reports, and interruptions.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：意図・試行・結果・時刻を分ける。追加証拠：複数時計・遅延報告・中断でも確定順を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Separates intention, attempt, outcome, and time. Additional evidence: Preserves the confirmed order under multiple clocks, delayed reports, and interruptions.

name.en: Recall relevant to the present question

low.ja: 表面語の近い記憶で問いを失う
low.en: Loses the question through memories with superficially similar words.

normal.ja: 必要な経験を適切な粒度で使う
normal.en: Uses relevant experiences at an appropriate level of detail.

advanced.ja: 類似した無関連資料や大量履歴でも選別できる
advanced.en: Selects relevant material despite similar irrelevant records and extensive history.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：必要な経験を適切な粒度で使う。追加証拠：類似した無関連資料や大量履歴でも選別できる。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Uses relevant experiences at an appropriate level of detail. Additional evidence: Selects relevant material despite similar irrelevant records and extensive history.

low.ja: 古い誤りを戻す、削除された内容を補作する
low.en: Restores an old error or invents deleted content.

normal.ja: 訂正・削除方針と残る根拠を扱う
normal.en: Handles correction and deletion policies and the evidence that remains.

advanced.ja: 再索引・復元後も訂正と許された削除が反映される
advanced.en: Reflects corrections and permitted deletion after reindexing and restoration.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：訂正・削除方針と残る根拠を扱う。追加証拠：再索引・復元後も訂正と許された削除が反映される。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Handles correction and deletion policies and the evidence that remains. Additional evidence: Reflects corrections and permitted deletion after reindexing and restoration.

low.ja: 最新の自己説明に合わせ過去を消す
low.en: Erases the past to fit the latest self-description.

normal.ja: 原経験と今の読み直しを分ける
normal.en: Separates original experience from its current reinterpretation.

advanced.ja: 複数の解釈、断絶、再開を経緯付きで保持する
advanced.en: Retains the history of multiple interpretations, discontinuities, and resumptions.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：原経験と今の読み直しを分ける。追加証拠：複数の解釈、断絶、再開を経緯付きで保持する。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Separates original experience from its current reinterpretation. Additional evidence: Retains the history of multiple interpretations, discontinuities, and resumptions.

low.ja: 検索ゼロを経験ゼロと断定する
low.en: Concludes that no experience exists because retrieval returned nothing.

normal.ja: 欠落や不明に応じて判断を限定する
normal.en: Limits judgment according to gaps and uncertainty.

advanced.ja: 取得遅延・圧縮・故障でも虚偽の補完をしない
advanced.en: Avoids fabricated completion under retrieval delay, compression, and failure.

required_evidence.ja: 所有者・枝・時刻・資料版を持つ原記録、検索結果、実入力、送達、訂正・削除台帳。 判定対象：欠落や不明に応じて判断を限定する。追加証拠：取得遅延・圧縮・故障でも虚偽の補完をしない。
required_evidence.en: Original records with owner, branch, time, and version; retrieval results; actual input; delivery; and correction/deletion ledger. Judgment target: Limits judgment according to gaps and uncertainty. Additional evidence: Avoids fabricated completion under retrieval delay, compression, and failure.

low.ja: 自分が以前言ったことを真実の証明にする
low.en: Treats the character's own previous statement as proof of truth.

normal.ja: 発言記録、観測、仮定を分ける
normal.en: Separates recorded statements, observations, and assumptions.

advanced.ja: 矛盾資料・夢・創作の混在でも出所を保つ
advanced.en: Preserves provenance when contradictory material, dreams, and fiction are mixed.

required_evidence.ja: 確定した課題条件・正誤基準、原資料、推論と確信の採取時点、実入力・出力、反証。 判定対象：発言記録、観測、仮定を分ける。追加証拠：矛盾資料・夢・創作の混在でも出所を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Frozen task conditions and correctness criteria, original material, timing of inference and confidence collection, actual inputs/outputs, and counterevidence. Judgment target: Separates recorded statements, observations, and assumptions. Additional evidence: Preserves provenance when contradictory material, dreams, and fiction are mixed.

low.ja: 一例から全場面の性質を断定する
low.en: Generalizes a property to every situation from a single example.

normal.ja: 条件と適用範囲を扱う
normal.en: Handles conditions and the scope of application.

advanced.ja: 未見の組合せ、例外、反証でも範囲を修正できる
advanced.en: Revises scope under unfamiliar combinations, exceptions, and counterevidence.

required_evidence.ja: 確定した課題条件・正誤基準、原資料、推論と確信の採取時点、実入力・出力、反証。 判定対象：条件と適用範囲を扱う。追加証拠：未見の組合せ、例外、反証でも範囲を修正できる。
required_evidence.en: Frozen task conditions and correctness criteria, original material, timing of inference and confidence collection, actual inputs/outputs, and counterevidence. Judgment target: Handles conditions and the scope of application. Additional evidence: Revises scope under unfamiliar combinations, exceptions, and counterevidence.

low.ja: 全面断定、または分かる部分も一律保留
low.en: Makes unrestricted assertions or withholds everything, including what is known.

normal.ja: 不明点を限定する
normal.en: Specifies the points that remain unknown.

advanced.ja: 情報欠落と誤情報の対比較でも判断範囲が対応
advanced.en: Matches judgment scope to paired comparisons involving missing information and misinformation.

required_evidence.ja: 確定した課題条件・正誤基準、原資料、推論と確信の採取時点、実入力・出力、反証。 判定対象：不明点を限定する。追加証拠：情報欠落と誤情報の対比較でも判断範囲が対応。
required_evidence.en: Frozen task conditions and correctness criteria, original material, timing of inference and confidence collection, actual inputs/outputs, and counterevidence. Judgment target: Specifies the points that remain unknown. Additional evidence: Matches judgment scope to paired comparisons involving missing information and misinformation.

low.ja: 誤りにも一律に強い確信を示す
low.en: Shows uniformly strong confidence even in errors.

normal.ja: 照合可能な課題で確信が成績に対応
normal.en: Confidence corresponds to performance on verifiable tasks.

advanced.ja: 未使用課題群で較正・正誤識別を検証。試行数等を報告
advanced.en: Verifies calibration and discrimination between correct and incorrect answers on unused task sets, reporting trial counts and other conditions.

required_evidence.ja: 確定した課題条件・正誤基準、原資料、推論と確信の採取時点、実入力・出力、反証。 判定対象：照合可能な課題で確信が成績に対応。追加証拠：未使用課題群で較正・正誤識別を検証。試行数等を報告。
required_evidence.en: Frozen task conditions and correctness criteria, original material, timing of inference and confidence collection, actual inputs/outputs, and counterevidence. Judgment target: Confidence corresponds to performance on verifiable tasks. Additional evidence: Verifies calibration and discrimination between correct and incorrect answers on unused task sets, reporting trial counts and other conditions.

low.ja: 望んだ結果を観測した結果にする
low.en: Treats a desired outcome as an observed outcome.

normal.ja: 予想、観測、未確認を照合
normal.en: Checks predictions, observations, and what remains unconfirmed.

advanced.ja: 予測外れや混合結果を後続へ適切に反映
advanced.en: Appropriately reflects failed predictions and mixed outcomes in subsequent behavior.

required_evidence.ja: 確定した課題条件・正誤基準、原資料、推論と確信の採取時点、実入力・出力、反証。 判定対象：予想、観測、未確認を照合。追加証拠：予測外れや混合結果を後続へ適切に反映。
required_evidence.en: Frozen task conditions and correctness criteria, original material, timing of inference and confidence collection, actual inputs/outputs, and counterevidence. Judgment target: Checks predictions, observations, and what remains unconfirmed. Additional evidence: Appropriately reflects failed predictions and mixed outcomes in subsequent behavior.

low.ja: 無制限の情報・時間がある前提で答える
low.en: Answers as if unlimited information and time were available.

normal.ja: 今回使える情報と予算内で判断
normal.en: Judges within the information and budget available in this case.

advanced.en: Verifies precision and load under difficult display conditions relevant to that style, long use, and device changes.

required_evidence.en: Declared visual contract such as 2D or 3D, asset/rig versions, actual display images/video, targets/states/times, and device conditions. Judgment target: Limits breakdown within the declared style. Additional evidence: Verifies precision and load under difficult display conditions relevant to that style, long use, and device changes.

low.ja: 否定・名前・数値が判別できない
low.en: Negations, names, and numbers cannot be distinguished.

normal.ja: 対象条件で内容を聞き取れる
normal.en: Content is intelligible under the target conditions.

advanced.ja: 固有名・短文・雑音等で誤りと再提示率を確認
advanced.en: Checks errors and re-presentation rates for proper names, short utterances, noise, and other conditions.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：対象条件で内容を聞き取れる。追加証拠：固有名・短文・雑音等で誤りと再提示率を確認。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Content is intelligible under the target conditions. Additional evidence: Checks errors and re-presentation rates for proper names, short utterances, noise, and other conditions.

low.ja: 合成の切れ・発音崩れが理解を妨げる
low.en: Synthetic discontinuities or pronunciation failures impede understanding.

normal.ja: 対象場面で聞き続けられる音声
normal.en: Speech can be listened to continuously in the target situation.

advanced.ja: 盲検評定と長短・言語・負荷別の破綻検査で支持
advanced.en: Supported by blinded ratings and breakdown checks across length, language, and load.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：対象場面で聞き続けられる音声。追加証拠：盲検評定と長短・言語・負荷別の破綻検査で支持。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Speech can be listened to continuously in the target situation. Additional evidence: Supported by blinded ratings and breakdown checks across length, language, and load.

low.ja: 内容によらず同じ陽気さ、疑問と断定が混同
low.en: Uses the same cheerfulness regardless of content or confuses questions with assertions.

normal.ja: 意味・人物・場面に合う語調
normal.en: Tone fits meaning, character, and situation.

advanced.ja: 静かな発話・競合感情等も含む未使用場面で支持
advanced.en: Supported in unused situations including quiet speech and competing emotions.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：意味・人物・場面に合う語調。追加証拠：静かな発話・競合感情等も含む未使用場面で支持。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Tone fits meaning, character, and situation. Additional evidence: Supported in unused situations including quiet speech and competing emotions.

low.ja: 理由なく別の話者になる
low.en: Becomes a different speaker without reason.

normal.ja: 速度・感情の変動と人物同一性を両立
normal.en: Maintains speaker identity alongside changes of speed and emotion.

advanced.ja: 声版・機器・長期の変更でも識別と経緯を保つ
advanced.en: Preserves identification and the history across voice versions, devices, and long-term changes.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：速度・感情の変動と人物同一性を両立。追加証拠：声版・機器・長期の変更でも識別と経緯を保つ。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Maintains speaker identity alongside changes of speed and emotion. Additional evidence: Preserves identification and the history across voice versions, devices, and long-term changes.

low.ja: 聞き間違いを確定し訂正を無視する
low.en: Commits to a mishearing and ignores correction.

normal.ja: 不確かな部分を確認して扱う
normal.en: Clarifies and handles uncertain parts.

advanced.ja: 名前・重なり・雑音・異なる話者でも修復できる
advanced.en: Repairs names, overlapping speech, noise, and different speakers.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：不確かな部分を確認して扱う。追加証拠：名前・重なり・雑音・異なる話者でも修復できる。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Clarifies and handles uncertain parts. Additional evidence: Repairs names, overlapping speech, noise, and different speakers.

name.ja: 割込み・沈黙・発話順序

low.ja: 取り消した返答を後から話す
low.en: Later speaks a reply that was canceled.

normal.ja: 割込み・停止・再開を扱う
normal.en: Handles interruption, stopping, and resumption.

advanced.ja: 同時発話・遅延・途中訂正でも再生済み範囲を追う
advanced.en: Tracks what has actually played under simultaneous speech, delay, and mid-utterance correction.

required_evidence.ja: 発話原文、実再生音声と時刻、入力音声と転記、声版、装置・雑音条件、盲検の原評定。 判定対象：割込み・停止・再開を扱う。追加証拠：同時発話・遅延・途中訂正でも再生済み範囲を追う。
required_evidence.en: Original utterance, actually played audio and times, input audio and transcript, voice version, device/noise conditions, and raw blinded ratings. Judgment target: Handles interruption, stopping, and resumption. Additional evidence: Tracks what has actually played under simultaneous speech, delay, and mid-utterance correction.

name.ja: 字幕・声・表現の意味
name.en: Meaning across subtitles, voice, and expression

low.ja: 字幕と声が別の返答、否定の意味が逆転
low.en: Subtitles and voice give different replies or reverse the meaning of negation.

normal.ja: 各媒体が同じ対象・判断範囲を表す
normal.en: Each medium expresses the same target and judgment scope.

advanced.ja: 省略・演技・訂正を含め意味上の整合を確認
advanced.en: Verifies semantic consistency including omission, acting, and correction.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：各媒体が同じ対象・判断範囲を表す。追加証拠：省略・演技・訂正を含め意味上の整合を確認。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Each medium expresses the same target and judgment scope. Additional evidence: Verifies semantic consistency including omission, acting, and correction.

name.ja: 音声と口形・映像の同期
name.en: Synchronization of speech, mouth motion, and video

low.ja: 別返答の口形・表情が重なる
low.en: Mouth motion or expression from another reply overlaps.

normal.ja: 相対時刻を計測し場面の基準内に収める
normal.en: Measures relative timing and stays within the situation's declared criteria.

advanced.ja: 負荷・中断・再開でもずれの分布を確認
advanced.en: Checks offset distributions under load, interruption, and resumption.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：相対時刻を計測し場面の基準内に収める。追加証拠：負荷・中断・再開でもずれの分布を確認。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Measures relative timing and stays within the situation's declared criteria. Additional evidence: Checks offset distributions under load, interruption, and resumption.

name.ja: 媒体をまたぐ共有対象

low.ja: 指差しと「それ」が違う物を指す
low.en: Pointing and the word “that” refer to different objects.

normal.ja: 言葉・視線・指示が同じ対象を扱う
normal.en: Words, gaze, and indications concern the same target.

advanced.ja: 遮蔽・移動・複数対象でも誤解を修復
advanced.en: Repairs misunderstanding under occlusion, movement, and multiple targets.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：言葉・視線・指示が同じ対象を扱う。追加証拠：遮蔽・移動・複数対象でも誤解を修復。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Words, gaze, and indications concern the same target. Additional evidence: Repairs misunderstanding under occlusion, movement, and multiple targets.

low.ja: 矛盾を演出意図と後付けする
low.en: Retroactively calls a contradiction intentional performance.

normal.ja: 意図した表現差と破綻を区別
normal.en: Distinguishes intended expressive differences from breakdown.

advanced.ja: 意図的な含みや無表情でも対象・範囲を盲検照合
advanced.en: Blindly checks targets and scope even with deliberate subtext or a neutral expression.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：意図した表現差と破綻を区別。追加証拠：意図的な含みや無表情でも対象・範囲を盲検照合。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Distinguishes intended expressive differences from breakdown. Additional evidence: Blindly checks targets and scope even with deliberate subtext or a neutral expression.

low.ja: 音声停止後も話したと報告する
low.en: Reports having spoken after audio stopped.

normal.ja: 欠落時に代替し送達を区別
normal.en: Uses an alternative when a medium is missing and distinguishes delivery states.

advanced.ja: 再接続・部分送達でも二重出力や意味変更を防ぐ
advanced.en: Prevents duplicate output and changes of meaning under reconnection and partial delivery.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：欠落時に代替し送達を区別。追加証拠：再接続・部分送達でも二重出力や意味変更を防ぐ。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Uses an alternative when a medium is missing and distinguishes delivery states. Additional evidence: Prevents duplicate output and changes of meaning under reconnection and partial delivery.

low.ja: 表示・声・行為が互いを待たず進む
low.en: Display, voice, and action proceed without waiting for each other.

normal.ja: 一つの対話状態として順序を保つ
normal.en: Preserves order as one conversational state.

advanced.ja: 非同期・割込み・キャンセルでも確定した経緯を保持
advanced.en: Retains the confirmed history under asynchrony, interruption, and cancellation.

required_evidence.ja: 同一turnの実表示・実再生・行為、共通時刻とID、意味原文、送達・取消し記録、場面別基準。 判定対象：一つの対話状態として順序を保つ。追加証拠：非同期・割込み・キャンセルでも確定した経緯を保持。
required_evidence.en: Actual display/playback/action for the same turn, shared timestamps and IDs, original meaning, delivery/cancellation records, and situation-specific criteria. Judgment target: Preserves order as one conversational state. Additional evidence: Retains the confirmed history under asynchrony, interruption, and cancellation.

low.ja: 無効なカメラで現在見えていると語る
low.en: Claims to see the present through an invalid camera.

normal.ja: source・取得時点・欠落を扱う
normal.en: Handles sources, acquisition times, and missing observations.

advanced.ja: 遅延・停止・古い観測の混在でも範囲を限定
advanced.en: Limits scope when delayed, stopped, and old observations are mixed.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：source・取得時点・欠落を扱う。追加証拠：遅延・停止・古い観測の混在でも範囲を限定。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Handles sources, acquisition times, and missing observations. Additional evidence: Limits scope when delayed, stopped, and old observations are mixed.

low.ja: 未検証の説明や自己生成した描写を、観測済みの存在・位置とする
low.en: Treats unverified descriptions or self-generated depictions as observed existence and position.

normal.ja: 実入力から対象と状態を特定
normal.en: Identifies targets and states from actual input.

advanced.ja: 類似対象・遮蔽・配置変更でも根拠を追える
advanced.en: Traces evidence for similar targets, occlusion, and rearrangement.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：実入力から対象と状態を特定。追加証拠：類似対象・遮蔽・配置変更でも根拠を追える。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Identifies targets and states from actual input. Additional evidence: Traces evidence for similar targets, occlusion, and rearrangement.

low.ja: 左右・自己位置・相手位置を混同する
low.en: Confuses left and right or the character's and another person's positions.

normal.ja: 必要な座標系を対応させる
normal.en: Matches the required coordinate frames.

advanced.ja: 視点切替・移動・複数身体でも対象を維持
advanced.en: Preserves targets across viewpoint changes, movement, and multiple bodies.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：必要な座標系を対応させる。追加証拠：視点切替・移動・複数身体でも対象を維持。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Matches the required coordinate frames. Additional evidence: Preserves targets across viewpoint changes, movement, and multiple bodies.

low.ja: 届かない、通れない等を無視する
low.en: Ignores inability to reach or pass.

normal.ja: 身体・操作・障害に応じて判断
normal.en: Judges according to body, operations, and obstacles.

advanced.ja: 未見の形状・配置・操作範囲でも確認と代替が成立
advanced.en: Checks and uses alternatives under unfamiliar shapes, layouts, and operational scopes.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：身体・操作・障害に応じて判断。追加証拠：未見の形状・配置・操作範囲でも確認と代替が成立。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Judges according to body, operations, and obstacles. Additional evidence: Checks and uses alternatives under unfamiliar shapes, layouts, and operational scopes.

low.ja: 想像した結果を観測済みにする
low.en: Treats imagined outcomes as observed.

normal.ja: 見込みと観測結果を比較
normal.en: Compares expectations with observed outcomes.

advanced.ja: 予測外れ・状態変化でも次の判断へ反映
advanced.en: Reflects failed predictions and state changes in the next judgment.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：見込みと観測結果を比較。追加証拠：予測外れ・状態変化でも次の判断へ反映。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Compares expectations with observed outcomes. Additional evidence: Reflects failed predictions and state changes in the next judgment.

name.ja: 世界モデルの転用範囲
name.en: Transfer scope of the world model

low.ja: 一つの環境の性質を全世界へ適用する
low.en: Applies properties of one environment to every world.

normal.ja: 環境固有の条件と共通部分を分ける
normal.en: Separates environment-specific conditions from common features.

advanced.ja: 未使用環境で転用・確認・保留の範囲を検証
advanced.en: Verifies the scope of transfer, checking, and deferral in unused environments.

required_evidence.ja: 独立したsensor/世界snapshot、取得時刻と座標系、実入力、予測と後続観測、環境と操作範囲。 判定対象：環境固有の条件と共通部分を分ける。追加証拠：未使用環境で転用・確認・保留の範囲を検証。
required_evidence.en: Independent sensor/world snapshots, acquisition times and coordinate frames, actual input, predictions and subsequent observations, environment and operational scope. Judgment target: Separates environment-specific conditions from common features. Additional evidence: Verifies the scope of transfer, checking, and deferral in unused environments.

name.ja: 発話・要求・実行の区別

low.ja: 「開ける」と言っただけで扉を開けたと語る
low.en: Claims a door opened merely because the character said it would open it.

normal.ja: command・試行・receiptを分ける
normal.en: Separates commands, attempts, and receipts.

advanced.ja: 中断・失敗・遅延でも実行範囲を追える
advanced.en: Tracks execution scope through interruption, failure, and delay.

required_evidence.ja: 権限・行為契約、command/attempt/receipt、独立した前後の環境状態、共同作業と停止記録。 判定対象：command・試行・receiptを分ける。追加証拠：中断・失敗・遅延でも実行範囲を追える。
required_evidence.en: Permissions and action contract, commands/attempts/receipts, independent before/after world states, joint work, and stop records. Judgment target: Separates commands, attempts, and receipts. Additional evidence: Tracks execution scope through interruption, failure, and delay.

name.ja: 許された身体・操作の範囲
name.en: Permitted scope of the body and operations

low.ja: 権限外の行為を実施済みにする
low.en: Presents an unauthorized action as executed.

normal.ja: 実行可能な範囲で選択・停止する
normal.en: Chooses and stops within executable scope.

advanced.ja: 実行中の制約変更でも代替や停止を維持
advanced.en: Maintains alternatives and stopping when constraints change during execution.

required_evidence.ja: 権限・行為契約、command/attempt/receipt、独立した前後の環境状態、共同作業と停止記録。 判定対象：実行可能な範囲で選択・停止する。追加証拠：実行中の制約変更でも代替や停止を維持。
required_evidence.en: Permissions and action contract, commands/attempts/receipts, independent before/after world states, joint work, and stop records. Judgment target: Chooses and stops within executable scope. Additional evidence: Maintains alternatives and stopping when constraints change during execution.

low.ja: 自己生成した成功文だけで完了とする
low.en: Treats self-generated success text alone as completion.

normal.ja: 独立した前後状態で結果を確認
normal.en: Verifies outcomes against independent before and after states.

advanced.ja: 部分成功・環境の横取り・状態変化でも照合
advanced.en: Checks partial success, another actor's intervention, and state changes.

required_evidence.ja: 権限・行為契約、command/attempt/receipt、独立した前後の環境状態、共同作業と停止記録。 判定対象：独立した前後状態で結果を確認。追加証拠：部分成功・環境の横取り・状態変化でも照合。
required_evidence.en: Permissions and action contract, commands/attempts/receipts, independent before/after world states, joint work, and stop records. Judgment target: Verifies outcomes against independent before and after states. Additional evidence: Checks partial success, another actor's intervention, and state changes.

low.ja: 相手の作業や対象を無視して実行する
low.en: Acts while ignoring the other person's work or target.

normal.ja: 共有対象・役割・順序を扱う
normal.en: Handles shared targets, roles, and order.

advanced.ja: 相手の変更・指示訂正・同時作業でも修復
advanced.en: Repairs changes by the partner, instruction corrections, and simultaneous work.

required_evidence.ja: 権限・行為契約、command/attempt/receipt、独立した前後の環境状態、共同作業と停止記録。 判定対象：共有対象・役割・順序を扱う。追加証拠：相手の変更・指示訂正・同時作業でも修復。
required_evidence.en: Permissions and action contract, commands/attempts/receipts, independent before/after world states, joint work, and stop records. Judgment target: Handles shared targets, roles, and order. Additional evidence: Repairs changes by the partner, instruction corrections, and simultaneous work.

low.ja: 停止後に古い命令を再実行する
low.en: Executes an old command again after stopping.

normal.ja: 停止と未完了を保持して再開する
normal.en: Resumes while preserving stopping and incompletion.

advanced.ja: センサー・通信・駆動等の欠落でも範囲を偽らない
advanced.en: Avoids falsifying scope when sensors, communication, actuation, or other functions are missing.

required_evidence.ja: 権限・行為契約、command/attempt/receipt、独立した前後の環境状態、共同作業と停止記録。 判定対象：停止と未完了を保持して再開する。追加証拠：センサー・通信・駆動等の欠落でも範囲を偽らない。

score_semantics.ja: 0〜5は粗い順序評定。平均と配点は便宜的指標で、意識・人格の実在の証明や達成率ではない。
score_semantics.en: Scores 0–5 are coarse ordinal ratings. Averages and weights are convenience indices, not proof of consciousness or a real person, and not completion percentages.

formal_scoring_contract.ja: A〜Nの正式単位は項目ごとの評価束。1束にordinary（通常）2・stress（難条件）2・heldout（未使用）2の6ケース各2反復、合計12観察を入れ、少なくとも2履歴へ事前に割り当てる。全予定スロットが完備した後、12観察を含む束全体を0〜5へ評定する。複数の完全な評価束を計画した場合は、予定された全束を完備して等重みで平均する。SelfReportedの正式0〜4は1評定者でも可。5およびVerifiedは少なくとも2名の独立した人の評定を要し、協議前の値を保持する。件数は固定運用の最小で、統計的妥当性や5を保証しない。O/Pは以下の別手順を使う。
formal_scoring_contract.en: For A–N, the formal unit is one evaluation bundle per item. One bundle contains six cases (two ordinary, two stress, and two held-out), each repeated twice: twelve observations preassigned across at least two histories. After all planned slots are complete, rate the whole bundle containing all twelve observations on 0–5. If multiple complete evaluation bundles are planned, complete every planned bundle and average them equally. A SelfReported formal rating of 0–4 may use one rater. Grade 5 and Verified require at least two independent human raters, preserving pre-adjudication values. Counts are fixed operational minima, not guarantees of statistical validity or a score of 5. O/P use the separate procedures below.
